issues.issue: The county treasurer balances are printed on Exhibit A but sit outside the fund balance lines, and they are not recorded anywhere. Under the 'cash wherever printed' rule, a person may want them as Cash and Cash Equivalents. Fordyce_FY2024 treats them the same way (not recorded), so the two years are consistent.
